name: editExtraCurricularActivityCategory
description: Updates the name of an existing extra curricular activity category in the system.
taskName: Editing Extra Curricular Activity Category Details

basic.name: editExtraCurricularActivityCategory
basic.description: Updates the name of an existing extra curricular activity category in the system.

args.name: categoryCode
args.description: The unique code identifier for the category to update (e.g., "000001")

args.name: categoryName
args.description: The current name of the category to update (e.g., "Arts / Creative"); optional

args.name: newCategoryName
args.description: The new name for the category (e.g., "Arts / Creative update")
